title: Baselines manifest v1
description: `baselines/eval/manifest.json`: the index of the eval baselines `baseline save` copied, read by `baseline list` and `baseline compare`. It is rewritten by every save, so it carries no run envelope. A manifest saved before this schema has no `schema_version` and is still read; the next save stamps it. An entry is held to what `baseline list` and `baseline compare` require (a string `name` and `path`, an object `summary` if any) and no more, so an entry they read is one a later save keeps; other keys are kept as they are.

path.description: The saved copy of the eval file.

saved_at.description: UTC, %Y%m%dT%H%M%S%f as `baseline save` writes it; printed as it is.

summary.description: The means over the eval's complete pairs (`n`, `avg_with`, `avg_without`, `avg_delta`), as `baseline save` writes them; {} when it has none. Printed as they are.
